C-528 NO. 752 of 2025
Hon'ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. D.P. Mittal, learned counsel for the Applicants.
2. Mr. B.C. Joshi, learned A.G.A. for the State of
Uttarakhand.
3. Mr. Shubhr Rastogi, learned counsel for the private
Respondent.
4. A Correction Application (M.C.R.C. No. 2 of 2025) has
been filed by the Applicants with a prayer to modify the order
dated 16.06.2025, to the extent that the words "are hereby
quashed" be substituted with "are hereby quashed qua the
Applicants."
5. Upon due consideration, the Correction Application is
allowed.
6. Accordingly, paragraph no. 11 of the order dated
16.06.2025 shall now be read with the corrected words "are
hereby quashed qua the Applicants" in place of "are hereby
quashed."
7. The order dated 16.06.2025 stands corrected accordingly.
 (Ashish Naithani, J.)
 10.11.2025
